Owner query tested and confirmed. The parcelid here is an integer OBJECTID; the brt_id (9-digit string, e.g. '171006315') is the stable OPA/BRT account number used in the assessor system. For deeper property assessment data (market value, sale price, exemptions, zoning), the OPA Properties dataset at opendataphilly.org/datasets/opa-properties-public has 78+ fields but is distributed as a CSV/API download rather than a REST FeatureServer with geometry. Philadelphia parcels are city-county unified (Philadelphia City = Philadelphia County).

Parcel layer at layer index 6 of the Montgomery County Parcels service. Layer 0 does not exist and returns 'The requested layer (layerId: 0) was not found', so the index matters. 310,070 parcels with owner names on 302,241 rows (97.5 percent). One of the richer records in the registry at 122 columns, including a mailing address (ADDR1 through ADDR3 with ZIP1_ZIP2), a combined situs in LOCATION1, and split situs parts in LOC_NO, LOC_DIR, LOC_STR and LOC_SUF. The combined column is used, so no composite address assembly is needed.

Countywide parcel layer, 237,884 parcels with owner names on 237,576 rows, the highest owner coverage in this batch at 99.9 percent. Columns: PARCEL_NUM, OWNER1, OWNER2, CARE_OF, ADDRESS, MUNICIPALITY, plus land, building and total value. There is no mailing-address column, so owner mailing lookups are unavailable here even though owner names are not.

counties.notes: Bradford County, Pennsylvania (Towanda; FIPS 42015). The county's parcels are published through PASDA (Pennsylvania Spatial Data Access, the state clearinghouse run by Penn State) as BradfordCounty MapServer layer 5, 'Bradford County - Parcels 202511': 34,935 parcels, 34,918 of them with an owner, on 2026-10-08. The data is county-supplied; the host is PASDA, not the county, and the county's own GIS page was not confirmed to link this layer. The layer name carries a vintage stamp (202511, November 2025) and PASDA republishes under new names, so the layer index or name may change: list the service's layers and pick the one whose name starts 'Bradford County - Parcels'. The owner is NAME, a varchar(25), so long owner names are TRUNCATED at the source and an exact-name search on a long LLC name will miss; a prefix LIKE works. ADDRESS, CITY, STATE and ZIPCODE are the OWNER MAILING address (a SMITH FARMS II LLC row mails to Piscataway, NJ), not the situs, and ZIPCODE is stored as a number so leading zeros are lost. THERE IS NO SITUS ON THIS LAYER: situs lives on a separate point layer, MapServer layer 0 'Bradford County - Addresses 202511' (39,510 points; FullAddr, COMMUNITY, ZIP), joined by PARCEL = ParcelJoin. That layer carries no owner and its PARCEL key is numeric where ParcelJoin is text, so it is not registered as a second endpoint; an address search therefore cannot be served from this record, and owner, parcel id and a point lookup are what it offers. The parcel id is ParcelJoin, 16 digits (5107300161000000). maxRecordCount is 1000 with pagination. CORS: the server echoes the request Origin. No license text is published on the service. Verified 2026-10-08: owner SMITH returned rows (first SMITHKORS JEFFREY W, 772 MOON ST, New Albany, 0212400143000000, Albany Township); a point query at -76.5,41.78 returned SULLIVAN ROBERT J, 5107300161000000, North Towanda Township, 74.2 acres. Unofficial third-party Bradford parcel items on ArcGIS Online (a Pitt Bradford item, a Michael Baker shapefile) are not used.

counties.notes: Chester County, Pennsylvania (West Chester; FIPS 42029). The county's parcels are published through PASDA (Pennsylvania Spatial Data Access, the state clearinghouse run by Penn State) as ChesterCounty MapServer layer 11, 'Chester County Parcels 202610': 194,767 parcels on 2026-10-10, 193,293 of them with an owner (1,474 have a blank OWN1). The data is county-supplied; the host is PASDA, not the county. PASDA REPUBLISHES MONTHLY under a new vintage stamp: the layer name carries the month (202610) and the name, and possibly the index, rotates on each republish, as it does for Bradford in this file. If the liveness probe flags this record, list the service's layers and pick the one whose name starts 'Chester County Parcels'. USE THIS HOST ONLY: an older copy at maps.pasda.psu.edu/arcgis (ChesterCounty MapServer 11, vintage 202312) answers 'Service not started' and is dead. The owner is OWN1 with OWN2; the situs is LOC_ADDRES (house number, street and type in one string, also split as ST_NUM, DIR, ST_NAME and ST_TYPE; blank on 7,747 rows, about 4%); the owner mailing address is ADDR1 (the street line) with ADDR2 (city and state in one string) and ADDR3 (usually blank), plus ZIP1; the parcel id is UPI (the Uniform Parcel Identifier, the county's tax id), with the map PIN in PIN_MAP and PIN_COMMON. MUNI is a numeric municipality code. Currency: MODIFY_DAT and ASMT_DATE (text dates) both peak at 2026-09-17, so owners are about three weeks behind the assessment office at this vintage. CORS: the server echoes the request Origin in Access-Control-Allow-Origin, also on the preflight. maxRecordCount is 1000 with pagination. No license or terms text is published on the service or layer. TLS: Python's Windows trust store has rejected this host's certificate chain; Node's fetch and curl accept it. Verified 2026-10-10: a count, resultRecordCount=1, an owner LIKE query (1,234 rows for %SMITH%), a situs LIKE query on MAIN ST (718 rows) and a point query at the county's internal point (one parcel, with an owner).

Westmoreland County, Pennsylvania (Greensburg; FIPS 42129). The county's own ArcGIS Enterprise 11.5 server (gis.westmorelandcountypa.gov), layer 2 'Parcels' of Upgrade/Parcels_AS400_VIEW_Upgrade MapServer: 191,739 parcels, county-only, so no scope clause is needed. The service is an export of the county's AS400 assessment system with 168 fields; the same service holds layer 0 'Lot Lines' (198,105) and layer 1 'Symbol Lines'. The parcel id is PARCELID (also UPI, MAP15 and PAR_ID); the owner is NAME (191,196 of 191,739 rows populated, 99.7%) with CO (care-of, 5,007 rows) and the grantors GNTR1 to GNTR3 on sale records; the situs is SITUS (191,196 populated; also FULL_ADDRESS, NUMBER, STR_NAME and TWNSHP_NAM); the owner mailing address is STREET1 (182,013 populated) with STREET2, CS (city), ST, ZIP (an integer column) and ZIPSFX. OWNER-NAME TRAP: NAME is a fixed-width 30-character string padded with trailing spaces, and the other text columns are padded the same way (STREET1 also starts with a space), so an exact NAME = 'X' never matches and every value comes back padded: search with UPPER(NAME) LIKE 'SMITH%' (a prefix, as the sample query does) or LIKE '%SMITH%', and trim the result. The server rejects TRIM() in a where clause (error -2147220985), so the padding cannot be stripped server-side. NAME is cut at 30 characters, so a long owner name or a joint owner can be truncated. The UrbanKit owner search wraps the term as UPPER(field) LIKE UPPER('%term%') and enrichment trims owner values, so neither is defeated by the padding; only a hand-written exact match is. ZIP is an integer, so ZIP <> '' errors: test it with IS NOT NULL. maxRecordCount is 2,000 with pagination. CORS: the server echoes the request Origin in Access-Control-Allow-Origin. CURRENCY: UPDATEDATE is stale (newest 2011-04-11) and the layer publishes no editing info, so neither is a currency signal; the sale fields are: SD1YR = 2026 on 7,011 parcels (read 2026-10-12), 775 of them with SD1MO of 9 or later and 81 of 10 or later, and SD1YR = 2025 on 9,610, so the assessment feed is live. DURABILITY: the service sits in a folder named 'Upgrade' and its name ends in _Upgrade, so the URL may move when the county finishes the upgrade; if the liveness probe flags this record, list the county server root for the Parcels_AS400_VIEW service. A sibling folder (GIT_Testing) requires a token. The statewide PASDA parcel layer does not include Westmoreland (39 sources, none of them Westmoreland) and carries no owner column, so this server is the only REST source. Unofficial ArcGIS Online copies exist (197,404 rows, edited 2026-10-01) and are not used. The county GIS page (westmorelandcountypa.gov/141/GIS) returned HTTP 403 to a scripted fetch, so the license terms were not read. Westmoreland County GIS: (724) 830-3415, 40 N Pennsylvania Ave, Suite 430, Greensburg PA 15601; Tax Assessment (724) 830-3409.

counties.notes: Berks County, Pennsylvania (Reading; FIPS 42011). The county's parcels are published through PASDA (Pennsylvania Spatial Data Access, the state clearinghouse run by Penn State) as BerksCounty MapServer layer 6, 'Berks County - Parcels 202601': 156,838 parcels on 2026-10-14, 156,146 of them with an owner (692 have a blank NAME1). The data is county-supplied (copyright 'County of Berks'); the host is PASDA, not the county. PASDA REPUBLISHES under a new vintage stamp: the layer name carries the month (202601) and the name, and possibly the index, rotates on each republish, as it does for Chester and Bradford in this file. If the liveness probe flags this record, list the service's layers and pick the one whose name starts 'Berks County - Parcels'. Currency: DATADATE is 2026-01-09 on the sampled rows (a January 2026 snapshot, about nine months behind at the time of verification), so owners can lag the assessment office. The owner is NAME1 (varchar 254, so no truncation of long LLC names); the situs is FULLSITEAD (one string, e.g. house number and street; populated on 156,145 rows); the owner mailing address is FULLMAILAD (one string, 156,146 rows); the parcel id is PROPID, a 14-digit string, with PIN as the map pin. MUNI is the municipality name. Do not read DEED_DATE as a currency signal: its maximum on the layer is a corrupt far-future date. The county's own ArcGIS Online item TaxParcelsNEBJCP (services3.arcgis.com/dGYe1jDYrTw1wwpc) covers only 5,830 parcels (a north-east subset) and is not used. CORS: the server echoes the request Origin in Access-Control-Allow-Origin. maxRecordCount is 2000 with pagination; the layer wkid is 4269 (NAD83), so a lon/lat point query takes inSR=4326. No license or terms text is published on the service. Verified 2026-10-14: owner LIKE %SMITH% returned 1,038 rows (10 with resultRecordCount=10), situs LIKE %MAIN ST% 2,614 rows, and a point query at -75.9269,40.3357 (Reading) returned one parcel in READING with a situs address.

counties.notes: Bedford County, Pennsylvania (Bedford; FIPS 42009). The county's parcels are published through PASDA (Pennsylvania Spatial Data Access, the state clearinghouse run by Penn State) as BedfordCounty MapServer layer 0, 'BedfordCountyParcels202307': 34,225 parcels on 2026-10-14, 34,104 of them with an owner (OWNER_NAME). The host is PASDA, not the county. THE VINTAGE IS OLD: the layer name carries 202307 (July 2023), more than three years before verification, and the layer has no edit-date or usable sale-date field (SALE_YEAR is a two-digit number), so owners can lag the assessment office by years. PASDA republishes under a new name, so the layer name or index may change: list the service's layers and pick the one whose name starts 'BedfordCountyParcels'. The parcel id is Name, the tax map number in the form E.09-D.04-111 (CONTROL_NO is a separate numeric control number). The owner is OWNER_NAME with OWNER_NA_1; the owner mailing address is OWNER_ADDR (with OWNER_AD_1, OWNER_AD_2, OWNER_CITY, OWNER_STAT and OWNER_ZIP, a number, so leading zeros are lost). SITUS IS SPARSE: SITUS_DESC holds a street address on only 8,885 of 34,225 rows (about 26 percent; some rows carry a road-name description such as 'OFF OF <road>' instead) and SITUS_DE_1 a free-text qualifier on 4,057, so an address search will miss most parcels; owner, parcel id and a point lookup are the dependable paths. municipali is the municipality name (blank on 1,202 rows). CORS: the server echoes the request Origin in Access-Control-Allow-Origin. maxRecordCount is 1000 with pagination; the layer wkid is 4269 (NAD83), so a lon/lat point query takes inSR=4326. No license text is published on the service. A second public copy, 'Parcels - PA - Bedford County' on a GDIT ArcGIS Online service (33,828 rows, layer description 'May2018Parcels'), is older still and is not used. Verified 2026-10-14: owner LIKE %SMITH% returned 454 rows (10 with resultRecordCount=10), situs LIKE %MAIN% 122 rows, and a point query at -78.5039,40.0186 (Bedford) returned one parcel in BEDFORD BORO.

Lancaster County, Pennsylvania (FIPS 42071) sells its parcel data with owner names. The county GIS Division offers it through the LanCo View PLUS and Data Hub Premium subscription, and the Property Assessment Office sells assessment data files. The free copy the county publishes through PASDA is parcel data without owner names. The subscription license is for personal use, and the county does not allow its data to be reproduced or passed on without the commissioners' written permission, so this atlas does not index Lancaster County. Parcel and owner records are available through the county's own tools and products.

coverage.summary: Lancaster County sells parcel data with owner names through its LanCo View PLUS subscription, and its free public copy has no owner names, so we don't index it. Search the county's own tools, or request it and we'll tell you if that changes.

counties.notes: Columbia County, Pennsylvania (county seat Bloomsburg; FIPS 42037). The county's parcel layer on PASDA, Columbia County Tax Parcels 202402 (34,249 parcels, last edited 2024-02-14), carries a parcel number (PIN) and geometry only, with no owner name, site address, mailing address, land use or value. The same query against Bradford County's PASDA layer returns owner names, so the gap lies in Columbia's data. The county's own map host, gismaps.columbiapa.org, has an expired TLS certificate, the county GIS page posts a notice that online mapping is down for that reason, and its REST paths return HTTP 403. Re-check once the county map server is back.

coverage.summary: Columbia County's public parcel layer has parcel numbers only, with no owner names or addresses, and the county's own map server is down behind an expired certificate, so we don't index it. Check the county GIS office, or request it and we'll tell you if that changes.
